basic.title: Staff Software Engineer
basic.summary: Staff Software Engineer with 18 years building and owning production systems at Wealthsimple, Google and CIBC, and a year of contract AI-training work on Snorkel AI and Handshake AI building agentic coding tasks and grading model-written code. Writes the tests, reference solutions and review criteria that decide whether code is actually correct, and reviews code daily, including output from AI coding assistants. Deepest in distributed systems, testing and code review, and judging AI output against written rubrics.

experience.title: Staff Software Engineer
bullets: Build full-stack and AI capabilities across Wealthsimple's Book of Record estate, spanning the Financial Activity Model (the single validated write funnel), the Financial Calculation Platform (streaming recomputation of derived views), and the Machine Learning Platform.

Architected the streaming recomputation and materialized views behind the Financial Calculation Platform, so every customer-facing surface derives from one record rather than from separate copies that drift apart.

Built deterministic test harnesses that replay duplicate, reordered and late events against the recomputation engine, so correctness and retry edge cases are proven before merge rather than found in production.

Review code and designs across the write funnel against written contracts and edge-case criteria, checking that an implementation matches its stated behaviour before it is promoted, including code drafted with AI coding assistants.

Embedded anomaly detection and exception classification on the Machine Learning Platform, and prototyped retrieval over internal policy and operations documents through the LLM Gateway, judged against evaluation sets and written accuracy criteria.
experience.notes: Four bullets mapped onto the anchor: write path (Book of Record / Financial Activity Model / controlled migration), read path (Financial Calculation Platform / read models), event-driven processing and reconciliation, and the ML decisioning layer. Bullet 4 deliberately covers the FULL model lifecycle (feature extraction, retraining, lineage, promotion, serving, monitoring) but welds every stage to a financial object - ledger events, activity history, reconciliation breaks, money-movement and back-office workflows - so a JD's named tooling (MLflow, SageMaker, TorchServe) attaches to the financial story instead of floating as generic MLOps. No stage is left empty, because an empty stage is a slot the model fills from reframed_jd. Number-free, matching deepankar/rowland/andrew.

experience.title: AI Training Contributor, Software Engineering (Contract)
bullets: Built terminal-based agentic coding tasks for frontier-model training: a task specification, a Dockerized environment, deterministic tests that decide correctness and a verified reference solution, calibrated so plausible but wrong fixes fail.

Graded model-written code and multi-step agent trajectories against detailed rubrics for correctness, edge cases, error handling and whether the tests actually prove the fix, with a written justification for every rating.
Reviewed other contributors' tasks and ratings for guideline adherence, and flagged ambiguous instructions and reward-hacking paths where an agent could pass the tests without solving the problem.
experience.notes: Real contract AI-training work (Snorkel AI expert network and Handshake AI), Sep 2025 - Aug 2026, alongside Wealthsimple. AI-platform resumes ONLY: never add to hansal_maniar (job applications leave it out on purpose). Project codenames (Terminus 3, Project Boson) are internal/NDA and deliberately not printed. Prints VERBATIM; compact keeps the first 3 bullets.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Built backend services and integrations that connected the cloud CRM used by sales and estimating with dispatch, telematics and job-cost systems, replacing manual re-keying between platforms that had grown up separately.

Delivered quoting and project workflows for ready-mix and construction operations, surfacing customer history and live operational data together so sales teams could price and commit work without leaving the application.
Developed data pipelines consolidating project, job-cost, materials and fleet telemetry into reporting models that gave operations and finance one reconcilable view across business units.
Built mobile-accessible field workflows and the APIs behind them so crews and dispatchers could record and retrieve operational data on site rather than routing everything through the office.
experience.notes: Company operated as Sunroc Corporation during this period; rebranded to Suncore Construction & Materials in 2025.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Built backend components in Google Ads serving, developing Java and C++ services that applied advertiser budget, pacing and eligibility constraints during latency-sensitive ad selection across global traffic.

Built reconciliation and correctness checks across the event-to-spend path so logged impressions, recorded clicks and spend calculations stayed consistent under retries, delayed events and pipeline reprocessing.

Reviewed Java and C++ changes to serving and pipeline code against the team's readiness criteria, tracing an implementation back to its written contract and rejecting changes that passed samples but broke edge cases.

Moved machine-learned relevance and conversion signals from offline evaluation into controlled online experiments, judging each candidate against held-out metrics before it reached production ranking.
Contributed to production readiness and shared on-call rotations for Ads services, tracing spend and serving regressions to root cause and documenting the verification steps that confirmed each fix.

Corpus is Google Ads in Kitchener-Waterloo: public Google sources confirm the KW engineering office worked on Ads, Gmail, Chrome, Fiber and OnHub in this period, but NOT that the candidate was on Ads - confirm the actual product/team and rebuild the corpus around it if different. Framed as CONTRIBUTOR, never as owner or lead of a Google project. Deliberately shares no distinctive phrasing with rowland_sipola's Google/Search bullets. Prints VERBATIM (index >= 2).

experience.title: Application Developer
bullets: Built client-facing banking applications and the digital-channel services behind them as CIBC extended from online banking into mobile, covering account access, transfers, bill payment and person-to-person money movement.

Developed integration layers between customer applications and core banking systems, isolating channel development from mainframe release cycles so new digital-channel features could evolve without waiting on core releases.
Implemented authentication, authorization and transaction security controls for a channel that was new to the bank, working within the audit and regulatory requirements of Canadian retail banking.
Delivered payment and transaction workflows with the availability and correctness guarantees money movement demands, including reconciliation and failure handling on client-initiated transfers.
